about: Time windows that apply after a Social Security overpayment notice. Each row is dated; a rule change is added as a new row, never an edit.

rows.plain: If you ask for an appeal or a waiver within 30 days, Social Security says it will not collect until it decides.
An appeal (request for reconsideration) is due within 60 days of the date you received the notice.
Social Security assumes you received the notice 5 days after the date printed on it, unless you show otherwise.
If the last day falls on a weekend or national holiday, the deadline moves to the next workday.
